title: The Year of the Lord's Favor

questions.question: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me, because the LORD has anointed me to bring good news to the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 61:1 (ESV): "to bring good news to the poor;"

questions.question: He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to those who are what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 61:1 (ESV): "and the opening of the prison to those who are bound;"

questions.question: To proclaim the year of the LORD's favor, and the day of vengeance of our what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 61:2 (ESV): "and the day of vengeance of our God;"

questions.question: To grant to those who mourn in Zion—to give them a beautiful headdress instead of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 61:3 (ESV): "a beautiful headdress instead of ashes,"

questions.question: The oil of gladness instead of mourning, the garment of praise instead of a faint what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 61:3 (ESV): "the garment of praise instead of a faint spirit;"

questions.question: That they may be called oaks of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he may be what?
They shall build up the ancient ruins; they shall raise up the former devastations; they shall repair the ruined what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 61:4 (ESV): "they shall repair the ruined cities,"

questions.question: Strangers shall stand and tend your flocks; foreigners shall be your plowmen and what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 61:5 (ESV): "foreigners shall be your plowmen and vinedressers;"

questions.question: But you shall be called the priests of the LORD; they shall speak of you as the ministers of our what?
You shall eat the wealth of the nations, and in their glory you shall what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 61:6 (ESV): "and in their glory you shall boast."

questions.question: Instead of your shame there shall be a double portion; instead of dishonor they shall rejoice in their what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 61:7 (ESV): "instead of dishonor they shall rejoice in their lot;"

questions.question: For I the LORD love justice; I hate robbery and wrong; I will faithfully give them their recompense, and I will make an everlasting what with them?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 61:8 (ESV): "and I will make an everlasting covenant with them."

questions.question: Their offspring shall be known among the nations, and their descendants in the midst of the peoples; all who see them shall acknowledge them, that they are an offspring the LORD has what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 61:9 (ESV): "that they are an offspring the LORD has blessed."

questions.question: For he has clothed me with the garments of salvation; he has covered me with the robe of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 61:10 (ESV): "he has covered me with the robe of righteousness,"

questions.question: For as the earth brings forth its sprouts, and as a garden causes what is sown in it to sprout up, so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to sprout up before whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 61:11 (ESV): "to sprout up before all the nations."
